parameters.query:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF($1, '')::date,
            CURRENT_DATE - 29
        ) AS date_from,
        COALESCE(
            NULLIF($2, '')::date,
            CURRENT_DATE
        ) AS date_to,
        COALESCE(NULLIF($3, '')::int, 5) AS top_limit,
        COALESCE(NULLIF($4, '')::int, 20) AS recent_limit
),

period_orders AS (
    SELECT o.*
    FROM orders o
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE o.created_at >= p.date_from
      AND o.created_at < p.date_to + 1
),

successful_orders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM period_orders
    WHERE status = 'closed'
      AND result = 'successful'
),

successful_order_subtotals AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS subtotal
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN successful_orders so ON so.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),

sales_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS confirmed_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(so.total), 0) AS total_sales,
        COALESCE(AVG(so.total), 0) AS average_order_value,
        COALESCE(
            SUM(COALESCE(s.subtotal, so.total) - so.total),
            0
        ) AS discount_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(s.subtotal, so.total)), 0) AS subtotal
    FROM successful_orders so
    LEFT JOIN successful_order_subtotals s
        ON s.order_id = so.id
),

order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'closed' AND result = 'successful'
        ) AS confirmed_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'closed' AND result = 'not_successful'
        ) AS failed_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'open'
        ) AS pending_orders
    FROM period_orders
),

top_products AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) AS gross_value
    FROM successful_orders so
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = so.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name
    ORDER BY units_sold DESC, gross_value DESC
    LIMIT (SELECT top_limit FROM params)
),

recent_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.status,
        o.result,
        o.total,
        o.discount_percent,
        o.created_at,
        c.id AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(c.name, c.username, 'Unknown') AS customer_name
    FROM period_orders o
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    ORDER BY o.created_at DESC
    LIMIT (SELECT recent_limit FROM params)
),

customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_vip) AS vip_customers
    FROM customers
),

returning_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id
        FROM orders
        WHERE status = 'closed'
          AND result = 'successful'
          AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY customer_id
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
    ) returning
),

product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_products,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_available) AS available_products
    FROM products
)

SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'period', jsonb_build_object(
        'from', params.date_from,
        'to', params.date_to
    ),

    'sales_overview', jsonb_build_object(
        'total_sales', sales_metrics.total_sales,
        'subtotal', sales_metrics.subtotal,
        'discount_value', sales_metrics.discount_value,
        'average_order_value', sales_metrics.average_order_value
    ),

    'orders', jsonb_build_object(
        'total', order_counts.total_orders,
        'confirmed', order_counts.confirmed_orders,
        'failed', order_counts.failed_orders,
        'pending', order_counts.pending_orders
    ),

    'top_products', COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(tp))
            FROM top_products tp
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ),

    'recent_orders', COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ro) ORDER BY ro.created_at DESC)
            FROM recent_orders ro
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ),

    'customers', jsonb_build_object(
        'total', customer_metrics.total_customers,
        'vip', customer_metrics.vip_customers,
        'returning', returning_customers.total
    ),

    'products', jsonb_build_object(
        'total', product_metrics.total_products,
        'available', product_metrics.available_products
    )
) AS dashboard
FROM params
CROSS JOIN sales_metrics
CROSS JOIN order_counts
CROSS JOIN customer_metrics
CROSS JOIN returning_customers
CROSS JOIN product_metrics;
